title: stale_at_check.sh and absent_at_check.sh each define the thread canon directory and differ on what an unreadable row is
body: Found by critic-shell on ST0096 WP-03 (devbin-dc's bank 9e0bba25f, read by dc 2026-11-20). Both ST0056 parity tools now read AT rows from intent/.canon/st/<ID>.json, but each defines CANON_DIR itself (two homes for one path, Highlander), and they disagree on an unreadable row: stale_at refuses with exit 2, absent_at answers otherwise. Remedy: one shared reading of the thread canon in lib_citation.sh (or a sibling helper both source), with one stated answer for an unreadable row, and both tools sourcing it. Owner: dc, as a devbin-dc unit. Rides this release (hv decision 69).
